notes: A116731_conjecture: for n >= 1, the number of distinct (flips, iterations) pairs of bubble sort (repeat left-to-right passes until no swap; iterations = passes that swapped) over (List.range' 1 n).permutations is (n^3+5n-3n^2)/3. Route: one pass lowers each positive left-greater count c(v) by 1 and swaps once per positive c(v) (pass_cgb, pass_swaps), so bubble = (sum c, max c) (bubble_eq); pairs = {(0,0)} u {(i,b): 1<=b<=n-1, b<=i<=M(b)} (bubble_mem_P via c(v) <= n-v; P_sub via insertion construction and a greedy table); card via 2M(b) = 2bn-b^2-b. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: A116731 as defined (Av(321,2143,3124)) = (n^3-3n^2+5n)/3 (entry formula/g.f., Pudwell 2005; checked n <= 8 by certificate/check.py); reading of 'a bubble sort program' (four loop variants give the same counts, n <= 9).
